n, m, mo = map(int, input().split())

# Initialize combination table C
size = n + m + 2
C = [[0] * (size) for _ in range(size)]
C[0][0] = 1
for i in range(1, size):
    C[i][0] = 1
    for j in range(1, i + 1):
        C[i][j] = (C[i - 1][j] + C[i - 1][j - 1]) % mo

# Initialize f and g arrays
f = [0] * (n + 1)
g = [0] * (n + 1)
f[0] = 1
g[0] = 0
if n >= 1:
    f[1] = 2
    g[1] = 0

for i in range(2, n + 1):
    f[i] = (f[i] + f[i - 1] * (i + 1) * 2) % mo
    g[i] = (g[i] + f[i - 1] * i % mo * (i - 1)) % mo
    g[i] = (g[i] + g[i - 1] * (i + 1) * 2) % mo
    for j in range(1, i - 1):
        k = i - j - 1
        tempF = (f[j] * f[k]) % mo
        tempF = (tempF * (j + k + 2)) % mo
        tempF = (tempF * C[j + k][k]) % mo
        f[i] = (f[i] + tempF) % mo

        tempG = ((g[j] * f[k]) % mo + (g[k] * f[j]) % mo) % mo
        tempG = (tempG * (j + k + 2)) % mo
        tempG = (tempG * C[j + k][k]) % mo
        g[i] = (g[i] + tempG) % mo

        sumHalf = (((j + 1) * j // 2) + ((k + 1) * k // 2)) % mo
        tempG2 = (f[j] * f[k]) % mo
        tempG2 = (tempG2 * C[j + k][k]) % mo
        tempG2 = (tempG2 * sumHalf) % mo
        g[i] = (g[i] + tempG2) % mo

# Initialize f0 and g0 tables
f0 = [[0] * (m + 1) for _ in range(m + 1)]
g0 = [[0] * (m + 1) for _ in range(m + 1)]
f0[0][0] = 1
g0[0][0] = 0

total = 0
for i in range(m + 1):
    for j in range(m + 1):
        if f0[i][j]:
            for k in range(1, m - j + 1):
                valF = (f0[i][j] * f[k]) % mo
                valG = (g0[i][j] * f[k] + f0[i][j] * g[k]) % mo
                f0[i + 1][j + k] = (f0[i + 1][j + k] + valF * C[j + k][k]) % mo
                g0[i + 1][j + k] = (g0[i + 1][j + k] + valG * C[j + k][k]) % mo

for i in range(1, m + 1):
    rem = n + 1 - m - i
    if rem >= 0:
        total = (total + g0[i][m] * C[rem][i + 1]) % mo

print(total)
